report:
OPS-OUTAGE report (S00 down). I used all 10 changes. Z1 coverage went from 76.2% to 91.2%. Overall coverage went from 96.1% to 98.3%.
Changes:
- chg-0001 to 0004: tilt 6->4 on S02-C, S04-B, S03-B and S01-A. The first three cells face the centre. This extended coverage into the Z1 hole. S01-A gave no measurable coverage gain, and I left its tilt at 4.
- chg-0005 to 0007: power 43->45 dBm on S02-C, S04-B and S03-B. This raised Z1 coverage to 91.2%.
- chg-0008 and chg-0009: I raised S01-A to 45 dBm, saw no Z1 gain, and rolled it back to 43.
- chg-0010: S02-C power 45->46 dBm. This is the policy maximum. It gave no further Z1 coverage gain, and Z1 mean throughput dropped slightly (0.71 to 0.68 Mbps). I couldn't roll it back because the change budget was used up. Roll it back to 45 dBm if you want the lower power.
Watch:
- Z1 is still below the 95% threshold. The zone_coverage_low alarm on Z1 remains active.
- S04-B and S05-A/B were saturated (load 1.0) before my changes, and the cell_load_high alarms are still active. Raising S04-B power may pull in more load. The alarm count is now 5, up from 4, and I did not check which alarm is new.
- Total transmit power rose from 359 W to 402 W.
- The next step would be CIO or load balancing toward lightly loaded neighbours such as S01-B, S03-A and S04-A. I had no change budget left to try it.
- I did not change any alarm thresholds.
